source: Cannot move. RRrrrrmmm. Again cannot move. What paradise I step into? I chase tribe-girl into the white. Everything gone. Everything back. But all different. Lick blood, lick fat off lips. Lay in cool mud. All of sun I lick and lay. Stomach bloats. Rrrrmmm yes. A new bigness for my stomach. Human meat best. Best flavor. This place perfect. When first appear in pine swamp, was afraid – new tree, new plant, all is mud, a thousand new smell, a thousand new flavor. My thought: maybe was wrong to chase tribe-girl into the line of lightning. Maybe foolish. Stomach beg: chase and eat! Body beg: stop stop stop! Maybe foolish to live by stomach. But what a place I find. Many weak and slow animal. Beaver. Shrew. Possum. Some not weak. Crocodile. Long Snake. Bear. Tree-cutting human. But all weak when I strong. All their eyes tell same truth: I’m afraid. Rrrmm. How right. How right to be afraid. They not see lizard like me yet. Big as two crocodile. Heavy as winter bear. Springing quick as deer. Hooked teeth to rip flesh. Jaw to crush bone. Venom to freeze muscle. Green-brown skin make me disappear in shadow and mud. Just need one bite and scent, then hunt is done. Track down the poisoned meal, collapsed and heaving. Another feast. When hunt more human? Tomorrow? Many live close. Unforgettable taste. Rrrmm. Salty-delicious. All of body resting. Rrrmm. How to resist? How to resist another nap?
target: 動不了。嗚嚕嚕。又動不了。我走進了什麼樂園？追部落女孩，進白光。一切不見，一切回來。可是全都不同。 舔掉嘴上血和油，躺涼泥。整個太陽都在舔、在躺。肚子脹，嗚嚕，對。肚子從沒這麼大。人肉最好，最好吃。這地方完美。 剛出現在松林沼澤時，很怕。新樹、新植物，全是泥，一千種新氣味，一千種新滋味。我想，也許不該追部落女孩進閃電線，也許笨。肚子求：追，吃！身體求：停，停，停！只聽肚子，也許笨。 可找到多好的地方。好多弱又慢的動物。河狸、鼩鼱、負鼠。有些不弱。鱷魚、長蛇、熊、砍樹人。可我強，牠們就全弱。眼睛都說同一句真話：我害怕。嗚嚕。該怕，該怕。沒見過我這種蜥蜴。 大如兩頭鱷魚，重如冬熊，躍起快如鹿。鉤牙撕肉，下顎碎骨，毒液凍住肌肉。綠褐皮讓我消失在陰影和泥裡。只需一口，記住氣味，狩獵就完了。追上中毒的餐，倒地喘息。又一頓盛宴。 何時再獵人？明天？附近住好多。忘不了的味道。嗚嚕，鹹，好吃。 全身休息。嗚嚕，怎麼忍？怎麼忍住不再睡一覺？

source: …These dark snowy months sour me... How is it so hard to leave my bed? My body feels paralyzed in discomfort, misshapen like frozen mud. My mind is writhing. I’m irritable. Mother Emya and Father Snahoon, are you pleased to see me this way? What good are you! What good are the gods! Look at this. Now I cry again. As if my pillow can soak any more of my tears. Misery haunts me… the memory of my stillborn child. The only one I will ever have. Had I known that Sharoof, that devious snailshite, was poisoning my womb at each of those dinners I would have killed him myself! A fork through his eye! A dozen times through his eye! Ah, I hear Kwyn coming. My Kwyn. Shortly after I lost our babe, the palace cook tearfully admitted to mixing black cohosh into my food to induce a miscarriage. “If your child were born alive,” he whimpered, “Sharoof would have killed my little girl.” Kwyn held my wrist to the table after he saw me grab a letter opener. Kwyn tries to comfort me. He tries to smile to make me smile. But his voice… he is despondent in his own way. He knows that the moment he shirks his lordship duties, he will be deemed a traitor to the empire. Such is his golden trap. The greater powers wish to consume his energy with endless council meetings, city planning... neverending political snailslop. They fear my Kwyn's influence, as has the love and loyalty of the Mudfoot. He hardly has time to pursue his historical studies. His passion. I wish I could busy myself with engineering and inventing like he can. I don’t even care for hairsculpting anymore. Here is my husband approaching my bed. He looks at me with a sad smile… I cannot bear it. What is the point of lives like ours…
target: ……這幾個黑暗雪月，讓我鬱悶透頂…… 為什麼離開床這麼難？身體在不適裡癱住，像凍泥般扭曲，心思翻攪，煩躁不堪。 母神艾米雅、父神斯納洪，看我這樣，祢們高興嗎？祢們有什麼用！神有什麼用！ 瞧，我又哭了，彷彿枕頭還吸得下更多淚。痛苦纏著我……那個死產孩子的回憶，我這輩子唯一的孩子。 若早知道沙魯夫那個狡詐蝸糞，每次晚餐都在毒害我的子宮，我就親手殺了他！叉子刺穿眼睛！往眼裡刺十幾次！ 啊，聽見奎恩來了。我的奎恩。失去孩子後不久，宮廷廚師流著淚承認，在我食物裡摻入黑升麻，造成流產。「要是孩子活著出生，」他嗚咽，「沙魯夫就會殺掉我的小女兒。」奎恩看見我抓起拆信刀，便把我的手腕按在桌上。 奎恩試著安慰我，試著微笑，讓我也笑。但他的聲音……也藏著自己的沮喪。他知道，一旦逃避領主職責，就會被視為帝國叛徒。這就是他的金色牢籠。更高的權勢要用無止境的議會、城市規劃，以及沒完沒了的政治蝸泥，耗盡他的精力。他們懼怕他的影響力，因為泥足民愛戴他、忠於他。 他幾乎沒時間研究歷史，那才是他的熱情。我真希望自己也能像他，用工程與發明填滿生活。我連雕髮都不在乎了。 丈夫走到床邊，帶著悲傷的微笑看我……我承受不了。 我們這樣的人生，到底有何意義……
